svg.title: Scenario catch rate and every observed result
svg.desc: Bars count the original planted values removed from identical positive scenarios. The matrix also shows two clean controls, ties, tag-only wins and the US phone case.

g.text: Same 13 positive scenarios for every library; matrix shows all results and clean controls.
Scenarios with the planted value removed (count; higher is better)
Masked means the original planted value disappeared; partial masks count. Kept is correct for the two controls.
embargo: default kinds, confidence 0 (default). go-masker: default policy, Luhn cards enabled, fixed tag rule.
masq: regex, name and tag rules. go-mask: field/tag rules. slog-formatter: PII fields. godlp: six built-in rules.
This measures these configurations, not production accuracy. Full synthetic outputs: doc/comparison-scenarios.json.
